facility_name: Texas Foster Care and Adoption Services
finding_summary: License revoked February 2023 after heightened monitoring; retained employee despite sexual abuse allegations; 88 deficiencies since Nov 2020; posed immediate risk to children
Substantiated physical abuse (RTB) March 2021; staff used improper restraint and corporal punishment while transporting child; citation for corporal punishment
48 minimum standards citations over five years (8 later reversed); monitors noted facility ill-equipped for high-runaway-risk youth
Multiple abuse/neglect allegations over months including broken jaw case; owner admitted not reporting every allegation; certification lost 2023
On heightened monitoring since Dec 2020; DFPS terminated contract Aug 2022 after failing to maintain administrator; no longer serving children
